dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: CityNet customer service, Rachel speaking. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɪti ˌnɛt ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜːrvɪs, ˈreɪtʃəl ˈspiːkɪŋ. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, Rachel. A technician was supposed to come at two o'clock, but it's four now, and nobody has come.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈreɪtʃəl. ə tɛkˈnɪʃən wʌz səˈpoʊst tə ˈkʌm ət ˈtuː əˈklɑːk, bʌt ɪts ˈfɔːr ˈnaʊ, ənd ˈnoʊbɑːdi hæz ˈkʌm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry about that. Do you have a case number?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri əˈbaʊt ˈðæt. duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈkeɪs ˌnʌmbər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's five, three, one, nine.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈfaɪv, ˈθriː, ˈwʌn, ˈnaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you. Let me check the status of your visit.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ˈlɛt miː ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈsteɪtəs əv jʊr ˈvɪzɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I've been waiting at home all afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪv bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ ət ˈhoʊm ˈɔːl ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I see the problem. His last job took longer than expected. I'll look into it right away.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː ðə ˈprɑːbləm. hɪz ˈlæst ˈdʒɑːb ˈtʊk ˈlɔːŋər ðən ɪkˈspɛktɪd. aɪl ˈlʊk ɪntə ɪt ˈraɪt əˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Please do. I've had no internet for five days!
dialogue.reading: ˈpliːz ˈduː. aɪv ˈhæd ˈnoʊ ˈɪntərnɛt fər ˈfaɪv ˈdeɪz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I understand. I'll make your case a priority, and I'll make sure someone comes today.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. aɪl ˈmeɪk jʊr ˈkeɪs ə praɪˈɔːrəti, ənd aɪl ˈmeɪk ˈʃʊr ˈsʌmwʌn ˈkʌmz təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. I'll call the technician myself, and I'll call you back as soon as possible.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪl ˈkɔːl ðə tɛkˈnɪʃən maɪˈsɛlf, ənd aɪl ˈkɔːl juː ˈbæk əz ˈsuːn əz ˈpɑːsəbəl.
